Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our follow-up, I pulled together a lightweight joint acceptance blueprint and a 10-day evaluation sprint sketch. The goal is to give your engineering and product teams a clear, timeboxed path to validate the integration and acceptance criteria without a heavy ops lift.

Files shared (editable):
- MAP-compact-template.gdoc (starter Mutual Action Plan with acceptance lanes + owners)
- 10-day-sprint-agenda.gslides (day-by-day agenda and demo checklist)

Quick asks:
1) Can you share the primary technical owner(s) at Vertex who should be in the "Engineering" lane?
2) Do the proposed acceptance criteria in the doc (performance, privacy, integration points) match how you measure success, or should we swap any of them for your metrics?
3) Are you available for a 30-minute kickoff next week to lock the schedule? I proposed Tue 7/24 10:00am PT and Thu 7/26 2:00pm PT in the doc — feel free to pick or suggest alternatives.

Notes on approach (in-doc):
- Day 0: env & credential handoff + quick smoke test
- Days 1-3: integration + small-scale throughput checks (shared test vector set)
- Days 4-7: feature validation & UX review (stakeholders: PM + Eng lead)
- Days 8-10: acceptance run & demo + signoff

Attachment stubs: MAP-compact-template.gdoc (Google Doc), 10-day-sprint-agenda.gslides (Slides).

Happy to iterate — added Marissa (CS) and Ben (Solutions Engineering) on cc for ops and deployment details.

Thanks,

Thanks Alex — great, I see your doc comments and added Jordan to the thread. Per our internal sync with Solutions Eng (Ben) I updated the "Engineering" lane and called out the following acceptance criteria snippet for the demo run:  

Acceptance criteria (excerpt — full list in MAP doc):
- Functional: end-to-end inference flow for the 3 canonical user stories must succeed 
- Performance: API latency < 200ms 95th percentile on the demo workload (as Alex requested)
- Data: test vectors masked/anonymized; no production PII in shared datasets
- Integration: successful KV cache warmup and prefix caching validated in a 5-minute smoke test
- Signoff: PM + Eng lead must confirm demo checklist items and postmortem notes within 48 hours of demo

Updated links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ExampleDoc (MAP-compact-template.gdoc - now includes Jordan as editor)
